contexts.text: The grape = charity, or what is holy. AC 1071:3.

The clusters thereof ripened [into] grapes () = the conjunction of spiritual truth with celestial good... Clusters = the truth of spiritual good; and grapes = the good of celestial truth... The conjunction of them in the Sensuous is circumstanced like the ripening of clusters into grapes... This is represented in the fruits of trees when they ripen; in unripe fruits, which are here the clusters, is represented the state when truth still predominates; but in the ripe fruits, which are here the grapes, the state when good has the predominance: the predominance of good is also represented in the flavour and sweetness which are perceived in ripe grapes.
To make grapes and eat the fruit of them () = to appropriate the goods thence derived.
To vintage the grapes of the earth () = to destroy all things of charity.
Grapes and clusters = the internal and external goods of that Church.
Their husbands came with grapes in their hands, of which some were of delicate flavour, and some of bad flavour; and the wives said. Why have you brought also bad grapes, or wild grapes. Explained.

Vintage the clusters of grapes of the vine of the earth () = the operation of the Lord... by means of the Divine truth of the Word into the works of charity and faith which are with the men of the Christian Church... By clusters of grapes and grapes are signified the works of charity... because they are the fruits of the vine in a vineyard... AR 651.
That grapes and clusters of grapes = the goods and the works of charity. Illustrated.
Because in the presses the must is expressed from the clusters of grapes.
By grapes are signified the goods of the Church; and by clusters of grapes, the truths of the Church.
By grapes are signified the goods thence, which are the goods of charity; and by clusters of grapes, the goods of faith.

Vintage the clusters of the earth, because its grapes are ripe = that there shall take place a gathering together and a separation of the good from the evil, because there are no longer truths of faith, in consequence of there being no spiritual good, which is charity.
Clusters = the goods and truths of faith; its grapes are ripe = because there are no longer the goods of charity.
That a cluster and a grape = the good of charity. Illustrated.
By clusters or bunches of grapes are properly signified the variations of the state of spiritual good, or the good of charity, because in them many grapes cohere together in a series.
The clusters and grapes which are put into the press...
